top_signals.title: Hong Kong’s Clearing Bank Gains New Funding Access in Yuan Push
top_signals.summary: Hong Kong’s sole yuan clearing bank plans to issue interbank negotiable certificates of deposit in the mainland market, another step in Chinese authorities’ efforts to strengthen the city’s role as a hub for yuan business.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
